name: Struggle
effect: Take 5% recoil damage after each use.

name: Tackle
description: The user charges into the target with its body.

name: Focus
effect: Raises the user's accuracy by 1 stage.
description: The user focuses its attention, raising its accuracy by 1 stage.

name: Disarm
effect: Lowers the target's defense by 1 stage.
description: The user disarms the target, lowering its defense by 1 stage.

name: Brace
effect: Raises the user's defense by 1 stage.
description: The user braces itself, raising its defense by 1 stage.

name: Burst
description: The user fires a burst of energy at the target.

name: Calm Down
effect: Raises the user's special defense by 1 stage.
description: The user calms itself, raising its special defense by 1 stage.

name: Pump Up
effect: Raises the user's attack by 1 stage.
description: The user pumps itself up, raising its attack by 1 stage.

name: Psych Up
effect: Raises the user's special attack by 1 stage.
description: The user psyches itself up, raising its special attack by 1 stage.

name: Leg Stretch
effect: Raises the user's speed by 1 stage.
description: The user stretches its legs, raising its speed by 1 stage.

name: Wood Double
effect: The user loses 1/16 of its MAX HP to create a wooden decoy in front of its active slot. The decoy has HP equal to the HP spent to create it. While the decoy remains, all techniques used against the user are directed to the decoy instead, preventing their damage and effects from affecting the user. The decoy breaks when its HP reaches 0 or the user leaves the active slot for any reason.
description: The user creates a wooden double to take techniques in its place.

name: Root Whip
description: The user whips the target with a root.

name: Heat Puff
description: The user blows a puff of hot air at the target.

name: Water Burst
description: The user blasts the target with a burst of water.

name: Startle
effect: Lowers the target's speed and special defense by 1 stage. Fails if not used on the first turn in the active slot.
description: The user startles the target immediately after entering the battle.

name: Shadow Claw
description: The user slashes at the target with claws made of shadows.

name: Slash
description: The user slashes at the target with a sharp item or claws.

name: Rain Call
effect: Causes rain for 5 turns.
description: The user calls for rain that lasts for 5 turns.

name: Sing
effect: Target is put to sleep for 2 to 5 turns.
description: The user sings a peaceful song which soothes the target to sleep.

name: Cosplay
effect: The user imitates the target's standard skill until it swaps out or faints. If the skill that the user attempts to copy is labeled as non-copyable this technique will always fail.
description: The user imitates the target's active skill by cosplaying as the target.

name: Method Act
effect: The user imitates the target's hidden skill until it swaps out or faints. If the skill that the user attempts to copy is labeled as non-copyable or the target does not currently have their hidden skill this technique will always fail.
description: The user imitates the target's hidden skill by method acting as the target.

name: Splash
effect: The target is given the condition of Soaked until either hit by a Pyro technique or swapped out which makes them weak to Electro techniques.
description: The user splashes water at the target dealing a little damage and making them Soaked.

name: Heart Song
effect: When this technique is used, if the user has a non-Audio Affinity that the target is weak to, this technique uses that Affinity’s offensive matchup instead and its power becomes 80.
description: The user sings a song from deep within their heart allowing the song to take on a different affinity.

name: Sandstorm
effect: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns.
description: The user kicks up a sandstorm that lasts for 5 turns.

name: Spatial Warp
effect: For 5 turns, the order in which techniques are used is inverted. Lower-priority techniques are used before higher-priority techniques, and within the same priority, slower Enitoy act before faster Enitoy.
description: The user creates a warped pocket of time around the battlefield that inverts the move order for 5 turns.

name: Spike Trap
effect: Spikes are set up on the opponent’s side of the battlefield. Whenever an Enitoy switches in, it loses 1/16 of its maximum HP.
description: The user coats the opponent's side in spikes that damage them upon switching out.

name: Resin Shards
effect: Shards are set up on the opponent’s side of the battlefield. Whenever an Enitoy switches in, it loses 1/16 of its maximum HP.
description: The user coats the opponent's side in shards of resin that damage them upon switching out.

name: Rocky Footing
effect: Rocks are set up on the opponent’s side of the battlefield. Whenever an Enitoy switches in, it loses 1/16 of its maximum HP.
description: The user coats the opponent's side in rocks that damage them upon switching out.

name: Thorny Vines
effect: Thorny vines are set up on the opponent’s side of the battlefield. Whenever an Enitoy switches in, it loses 1/16 of its maximum HP, and the user’s active Enitoy recovers HP equal to the damage dealt.
description: Thorny vines coat the opponent's side of the battlefield that sap a small amount of health upon switching out.

name: Deep Clean
effect: The target becomes Soaked until it is hit by a Pyro technique or switches out, making it weak to Electro techniques. If the target has the Terra, Toxic, or Umbra affinity, those affinities are also removed until the target switches out or faints. If this would leave the target with no affinity, it gains Ordinary instead.
description: The user used water to clean the target on a fundamental level.

name: Belch
effect: Fails unless the user has consumed a Berry since the last time it successfully used this technique. If successful, the target is poisoned. After this technique succeeds, the user must consume another Berry before it can successfully use Belch again.
description: The user lets out a foul belch after consuming a Berry, poisoning the target.

name: Trick-or-Treat
effect: The target is made weak to Spectral and Nox until they faint or swap out. This move fails if the target is already weak to Spectral or Nox.
description: The user and target get into the Halloween spirit, making the target weak to Spectral and Nox.

name: Weather Burst
effect: During a weather condition, this move's Stitching changes to match the weather and its Power increases to 80.
description: The user launches a burst that is modified by the immediate area's weather.

name: Bite
effect: Causes the opponent to flinch this turn if they haven't gone yet skipping their turn.
description: The user bites the target with a chance to flinch.
